label: Town of Cambridge
header:
# Town of Cambridge municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 5; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists five Cambridge Selectboard members: Toni Bryce, Brooke Chouinard, Cody Marsh, Angela Pratt, and Dan St Cyr.

Town of Cambridge, Certificate of Votes for the Annual Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (attested by Dana Warren, Town Clerk): Toni Bryce was elected to a three-year Selectboard term and Brooke Chouinard to a two-year term at the 2026 annual meeting.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Dana Warren as Town Clerk of Cambridge and as Town Treasurer of Cambridge.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Dana Warren as Town Clerk of Cambridge and as Town Treasurer of Cambridge.
Town of Cambridge, Certificate of Votes for the Annual Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (attested by Dana Warren, Town Clerk): Joel Page was elected Town Moderator for a one-year term.

Town of Cambridge, Certificate of Votes for the Annual Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (attested by Dana Warren, Town Clerk): Donna Hutchins was elected Auditor for a three-year term. The holders of the board's other two seats are not published in any official source read; they are left unfilled rather than guessed.
Town of Cambridge official website, Listers' Office page: 'Listers: Cora Conly, Dale Copping, Suzanne Girouard.'
Town of Cambridge, Certificate of Votes for the Annual Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (attested by Dana Warren, Town Clerk): Suzanne Girouard was re-elected Lister for a three-year term.
Town of Cambridge, Certificate of Votes for the Annual Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (attested by Dana Warren, Town Clerk): David Jones was elected Constable for a one-year term.

Town of Cambridge, Certificate of Votes for the Annual Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (attested by Dana Warren, Town Clerk): Dana Warren was elected Delinquent Tax Collector for a one-year term; the office is filled separately (17 V.S.A. section 2651d).

Town of Cambridge, Certificate of Votes for the Annual Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (attested by Dana Warren, Town Clerk): Carol Plante was elected Library Trustee for a five-year term and Cory Meier for a two-year term. The holders of the board's remaining seats are not published in any current official source read; they are left unfilled rather than guessed.

Town of Cambridge, Certificate of Votes for the Annual Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (attested by Dana Warren, Town Clerk): April Tuck was elected Trustee Public Funds for a three-year term. Cambridge elects a single trustee of public funds to successive three-year terms (Elise Raymond was elected in 2023); the post is recorded with one seat.

Town of Cambridge, Certificate of Votes for the Annual Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (attested by Dana Warren, Town Clerk): the Cemetery Commissioner five-year seat drew 'No nominations' at the 2026 annual meeting. Structure only: no official source publishes the board's current holders.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists nine Cambridge justices of the peace: Cora Conly, Rosemary D'Elia, Linda Davis, Adam Howard, Justin Marsh, Mark Nash, Jan Sander, Mark Schilling, and Denise Webster. Justin Marsh is a distinct person from Selectboard member Cody Marsh.

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists nine Cambridge justices of the peace for the 2025-2026 term; they are the winners of the November 5, 2024 election for the office. The listing publishes no vote totals and no party designations for justices of the peace.
